ai_settings_connection_scope: AI connection changes apply to the Rust-owned settings only and never read or write Compose settings.
ai_settings_import_unavailable: Local import reads only the static Codex or Claude configuration for the selected provider.
ai_settings_credential_status: Credentials are stored only in the AI runtime credential store, never in settings files.
ai_settings_models_unavailable: Model discovery requires a saved credential or a key entered for this connection.
ai_settings_valid: Configuration matches the trusted catalog. This is not a connection test or request approval.
ai_settings_invalid: Configuration is not in the trusted catalog. No request was made and no settings were saved.
ai_settings_package_unavailable: Package management is unavailable in the Rust runtime. Import, trust, version selection and removal remain disabled; no package code is loaded or executed.
ai_settings_allow_reports: Allow bounded local report artifacts after confirmation
ai_settings_allow_scripts: Allow registered scripts after sandbox preflight and confirmation
ai_settings_permissions_unavailable: Script execution requires a qualified sandbox; unavailable backends never fall back to ordinary shell execution.
ai_settings_report_unavailable: Report format and language are saved AI preferences and are frozen into each prepared run.
ai_settings_history_policy: Conversation history is stored in the Rust-owned AI database.
ai_settings_imported: Local configuration imported. Review the values and save to apply.
ai_settings_imported_without_key: Local configuration imported without a credential. Enter a key for this connection; another connection's secret is never reused.
ai_settings_import_not_found: No local configuration file was found for this provider.
ai_settings_import_malformed: The local configuration file is malformed.
ai_settings_import_denied: The local configuration file could not be read because permission was denied.
ai_settings_import_unsupported_auth: The local configuration uses a credential mechanism this app cannot import. Enter a key instead.
ai_settings_import_unsupported_config: The local configuration is not a supported provider configuration.
ai_settings_credential_configured: Credential configured in the system credential store. The secret is never shown or written to settings.
ai_settings_credential_missing: No credential is resolved for this connection. Enter one below; it is saved only through the credential store.
ai_settings_credential_required: A credential is required before saving.
ai_settings_models_empty: The server returned no models. Enter a model manually.
ai_settings_models_failed: The model list could not be loaded. {code}
ai_settings_models_endpoint_hint: Optional model-list endpoint for a gateway; it must share the API origin.
ai_settings_save_failed: The connection could not be saved (E_AI_CONNECTION_SAVE).
ai_settings_connection_required: Endpoint and model are required, and a credential must be configured or entered.
ai_settings_runtime_unavailable: The AI runtime is unavailable. Connection settings cannot be read or changed.
ai_settings_connection_note: Credentials are saved only through the AI runtime credential store; settings keep connection metadata only.
ai_settings_agent_chat_only: Chat only: used automatically for direct chat, never for evidence-bound analysis.
ai_settings_agent_unavailable: Agent packages cannot be imported, trusted, version-selected or removed in the Rust runtime. No package code is loaded or executed.
ai_settings_agent_aps_main_description: Evidence-bound performance reviewer for a frozen profiler analysis.
ai_settings_agent_aps_chat_description: Restricted conversational assistant without performance evidence, source or tools.
ai_settings_agents_read_only: Built-in agents are fixed in the Rust runtime and cannot be edited.
ai_settings_no_skills: No skills are connected in the Rust runtime. Built-in skills are not ported; skill execution requires a sandbox that is not available.
ai_settings_skill_unavailable: Skill packages cannot be imported, trusted, version-selected or removed in the Rust runtime. No skill code is loaded or executed.
ai_settings_scripts_unavailable: Script execution is unavailable: no qualified sandbox is linked in Rust, so this permission cannot be granted.
ai_settings_retention_note: Retention counts and days are saved AI preferences. The Rust runtime exposes a full clear rather than a bounded cleanup action.
ai_settings_history_note: Conversation history is stored in the Rust-owned AI database.
ai_settings_clear_history_confirm: Delete all stored AI conversations? This cannot be undone.
ai_settings_history_clear_failed: Conversation history could not be cleared (E_AI_HISTORY_CLEAR).
ai_settings_settings_save_failed: The AI preference could not be saved. {code}
ai_settings_retention_body: Keep at most 100 conversations from the last 30 days. Older and excess conversations will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
